scope: Explicit compiler selection inside the layout engine. Frontend compiler-profile selection is a separate layer.
compiler_support: Every upstream target default is retained. Explicit Clang overrides are accepted only for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu. Other overrides return UnsupportedCompiler.

focused.native_execution: 4 cases each with GCC13.3 and Clang18.1 on x86_64 Linux; bitfield probes zero the object representation then compare bytes against computed bit positions.
focused.cross_target: Clang18.1 checks enum/bitfield/nested layouts on both Linux architectures; GCC13.3 cross frontend checks AArch64 discriminator size/alignment/offset assertions.

fuzz.route: Existing semantic and checked-code fuzz targets still call toucan_target default layout; their resolved dependency is now toucan_layout.
